title: Jingwei Fills the Sea

source.book: Classic of Mountains and Seas, Northern Mountains
source.quote: The youngest daughter of the Yan Emperor was called Nüwa. She went boating on the Eastern Sea and drowned, and became the bird Jingwei, who forever carries wood and stone from the western hills to fill the Eastern Sea.

moral: The sea is huge and she carries one stone at a time — but she never stops.
